TitleModule.Headline: Tucson
TitleModule.Content: Choose Pulte Homes, one of Tucson’s leading home builders, as your premier choice for new home construction in Arizona. Build your dream home in one of our communities, some located less than 30 minutes from downtown Tucson, and enjoy this peaceful desert city with convenient access to the beautiful outdoor vistas of Saguaro National Park, the Rincon Mountains, and Catalina State Park. Our new homes for sale offer our exclusive Life Tested Home Designs® as well as our Smart Home features that connect your home for the way you live.

TitleModule.Headline: Phoenix
TitleModule.Content: Phoenix, Arizona has a vibrant culture with world-class arts, shopping, and dining options. With new home construction near major freeways about 30 minutes from Downtown Phoenix, you’ll be an easy ride away from Chase Field, Footprint Center, and Arizona Financial Theatre. Let Pulte Homes, one of Phoenix's top home builders, help you build the life you've dreamed of with our new homes for sale featuring Life Tested Home Designs® and Smart Home technology.
